items.title: Jr. Quality Assurance Engineer
items.description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. In this role, you will be responsible for testing software to identify bugs, performance issues, and usability concerns before they reach the end-user. You will work closely with developers and product managers to understand requirements and advocate for a high-quality user experience




Job Description:

Test Planning & Design

• Analyse business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications to create comprehensive test plans.

• Design, develop, and maintain detailed test cases and checklists.

• Identify test data requirements and prepare necessary data sets.




Test Execution

• Perform various types of testing including Functional, Regression, Integration, Smoke, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Execute manual test cases and/or develop and maintain automated test scripts (depending on the role focus).

• Document test results clearly and track software defects.

• Act as a super user for the applications and guide the end users for using the features & functionalities of the app




Defect Tracking & Management

• Log and track defects using bug tracking tools.

• Provide detailed steps to reproduce bugs and work with developers to troubleshoot issues.

• Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing to ensure fixes do not introduce new issues.




Collaboration & Communication

• Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

• Communicate testing progress, risks, and quality metrics to the team.

• Work closely with the development team to ensure quality is built into the product from the start.




Technical Skills

• Methodologies: Solid understanding of SDLC and STLC.

• Testing: Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, testing types, and defect management processes.

• Documentation: Experience creating test plans, test cases, and traceability matrices.

• Bug Tracking: Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Bugzilla, or Trello.

• API Testing: Hands-on experience testing APIs using Postman or Swagger.

• Database: Basic to intermediate SQL skills for data validation and back-end testing.

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

items.title: QA Frontend Automation Engineer
items.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
items.description:
Location: Abu Dhabi, Masdar City
Working hours: Full-time 

With our unified SaaS platform deltaconX, we simplify regulatory compliance, to streamline transaction reporting processes. Since the market launch in 2013, we have been committed to helping businesses meet evolving regulatory demands efficiently.
 
Our platform is the one stop shop for our clients to be compliant with key regulations like EMIR, MiFIR, SFTR, REMIT, MAS, HKMA and many more. As we continue to grow through our Go-Global initiative and strategic partnerships, we are looking for talented individuals to join us in shaping the future of regulatory compliance and delivering innovative solutions to our clients.

We are seeking an experienced QA Frontend Automation Engineer to join our team and play a pivotal role in expanding our frontend automation capabilities. Working closely with our QA Lead, you will help design and implement robust QA processes while further developing our Playwright and Python-based automation framework. You will ensure the quality and reliability of our Angular-based SaaS platform and help shape the future of QA within deltaconX.
Responsibilities
 * Design, implement, and execute manual test cases for our Angular-based frontend SaaS application.
 * Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve automated frontend UI and end-to-end test suites using our Playwright and Python-based automation framework.
 * Drive continuous improvements in frontend quality and testing strategy.
 * Support performance testing initiatives.
 * Document test results, defects, and processes in Jira & Confluence.
 * Collaborate closely with Frontend Developers, Product Management, UX, and Engineering teams to ensure high-quality feature delivery throughout the software development lifecycle.
 * Actively utilize modern AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, test quality, and automation development.
   
   
   

Requirements
 * Build and enhance our QA practices to support reliable and efficient software delivery.
 * Drive the adoption of manual and automated testing methodologies across our frontend development pipeline.
   
   
   

Benefits
 * Hands-on experience with Playwright is required.
 * Experience developing automated tests using Python is strongly preferred, as our automation framework is built using Playwright and Python.
 * Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining frontend UI automation and end-to-end test suites.
 * Strong understanding of manual testing procedures and test management processes.
 * Experience in performance testing.
 * Experience with automated backend testing (e.g. REST API or integration testing) is considered an advantage but is not the primary focus of this role.
 * ISTQB certification or equivalent experience (preferred).
 * Knowledge of Jira & Confluence.
 * Foundational SQL understanding (preferred).
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
 * Excellent written and spoken English language.
 * Self-organized, structured, proactive, and curious.
 * Ownership mindset with a drive for delivering high-quality software.
 * Open to adopting and working with modern AI-assisted tools as part of the daily workflow.
 * We can only consider applications from candidates who are already residents of the UAE.
   
   
   

We Offer You:
 * An interesting and varied job in a dynamic and ambitious company with flat hierarchies.
 * An international environment with the opportunity for continuous professional and personal development.
 * Flexible working hours with the option of working from home (up to 40%) after probation period.
 * Excellent infrastructure as well as attractive benefits.
   
   
   

We are dedicated to cultivating a fair and inclusive workplace rooted in trust and mutual respect. Embracing diversity is fundamental to our success, and we strive to build a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.

items.title: Quality Engineer
items.description:
The Product Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability and quality of the ATOM platform across complex, end-to-end workflows. This role combines functional and technical testing, working across frontend interfaces, backend APIs and data layers to validate system behaviour in a complex SaaS environment.

This is a hands-on quality role for someone who is product-aware, technically confident and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment. The role is responsible for maintaining and evolving automated regression suites, validating business-critical workflows, supporting rapid releases, and using modern tools - including AI-assisted testing - to improve speed, coverage and efficiency.

Functional & Technical Testing


 * Design and execute test scenarios across frontend, APIs and data layers
 * Validate complex business workflows in a SaaS / platform environment
 * Perform functional testing across user journeys, configurations and business-critical processes
   
   

API, Data & Backend Validation


 * Perform API testing and validate backend integrations, services and data flows
 * Work with databases, including PostgreSQL, to validate data accuracy, integrity and expected system behaviour
 * Test backend processes and integrations alongside frontend functionality to ensure end-to-end quality
   
   

Regression Suites & Quality Practices


 * Maintain and improve in-house automated regression suites and reusable test scripts
 * Identify gaps in test coverage and continuously improve quality practices across the platform
 * Contribute to test strategy, test planning, quality standards and release readiness activities
   
   

AI, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


 * Use AI-assisted testing tools and modern QA practices to improve efficiency, coverage and problem solving
 * Work closely with Product Owners, engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements, risks and acceptance criteria
   
   

Fast-Paced Delivery & Issue Resolution


 * Support rapid release cycles with reliable, repeatable testing processes and clear communication
 * Perform root cause analysis, support defect investigation and help engineering teams resolve issues quickly
   
   

Requirements


 * 4-7 years experience in QA / Quality Engineering within SaaS, platform-based or complex system environments
 * Strong experience testing both frontend and backend systems, including APIs, integrations and data flows
 * Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or similar
 * Experience working with relational databases, including SQL queries and PostgreSQL data validation
 * Experience maintaining regression test suites, test scripts and structured QA documentation
 * Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, engineers and cross-functional teams
   
   

Benefits


 * Work in an international environment
 * Innovation in FinTech
 * Private Health Insurance
 * Hybrid Working Model
 * Training & Development
 * Performance Bonus

items.title: Senior QA Engineer
items.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
items.description:
Key Responsibilities

 * Design, document, and execute test plans, test cases, and regression suites for web and mobile applications across multiple projects

 * Perform functional, usability, localization, and RTL (right-to-left) layout testing for Arabic-language interfaces

 * Validate Arabic content quality in AI outputs, including ASR transcriptions, classifications, and summaries — covering MSA, Gulf dialects, and Arabic-English code-switching scenarios

 * Test REST APIs and backend services (e.g., using Postman or similar tools)

 * Build and maintain automated test suites for UI and API layers

 * Log, track, and verify defects through to resolution; work closely with developers and product owners in an agile environment

 * Participate in UAT cycles with clients and support release readiness sign-off

 * Test data pipelines and platform workflows end-to-end, including user onboarding, task submission, and data validation flows

 * Contribute to QA process improvement, test documentation standards, and quality metrics reporting.
   
   

Required Qualifications

 * 5+ years of hands-on experience in software QA (manual and automation)

 * Native or fluent Arabic (reading, writing, listening) and professional working proficiency in English

 * Strong experience testing web and mobile applications (iOS/Android)

 * Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Appium

 * Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent)

 * Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, TestRail, orsimilar)

 * Understanding of agile/Scrum development processes

 * Strong analytical skills with meticulous attention to detail, particularly in evaluating Arabic text rendering, diacritics, and dialectal variation
   
   

Preferred / Nice to Have

 * Experience testing LLM-based or GenAI applications: prompt regression testing, evaluating non-deterministic outputs, hallucination detection,response quality scoring, and guardrail validation

 * Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests into them

 * Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript for test tooling
